content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Reviewers
content.note: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted up to and including 2020).
